digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify and External Integration Tests workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verify runs thousands of Pandoc corpus conversions consuming 184.32+ seconds on macOS critical path, necessitating relocation to external workflow
ADR 0095 mandates every conversion assertion use real Pandoc binary; ADR 0096 narrowly supersedes this clause for test execution boundary while preserving production renderer invariants

Three representative live corpus bodies (code_arrow, table, prose) plus compact pin/provenance probes remain in Gerrit Verify; complete replay moves to dedicated weekly/manual pandoc-corpus-replay job in external-integration.yml
External Integration Tests workflow is currently Ubuntu-only; implementation must add ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix for the new Pandoc corpus replay job
Version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprints must fail fast; deterministic regeneration and paired A/B implementation evidence are required
